concerns.location: spec.md:SC-005 vs FR-003/FR-007 and US-3 Scenario 3
concerns.text: SC-005 hard-codes '50 simulations + 100 null runs' completing within 6 hours, while FR-007 and US-3 Scenario 3 explicitly permit dynamically reducing the simulation count (e.g., 'from 50 to 20'). SC-005 as written would be unmeetable whenever the sanctioned reduction triggers. Reword SC-005 to reference the configured (possibly reduced) run counts, e.g., 'the full analysis pipeline with the configured Monte Carlo and null-run counts'.

Edge case says 'if the epidemic threshold is not reached in any of the 50 Monte Carlo runs', hard-coding 50 runs, which conflicts with FR-007's dynamic reduction of the run count. Reword to 'the configured number of Monte Carlo runs' for consistency.

Feature Branch is '001-gene-regulation', which does not match this project's feature (network proximity / epidemic spreading). Appears to be a copy-paste from an unrelated spec; should be e.g. '001-network-proximity-epidemic'.
